In detail

A large riverside district (the National Theatre, MOME campus, and a substantial residential core) named in the July 2025 citywide theft-hotspot map. A 2023 comparison of five inner districts (V, VII, VIII, IX, X) found Ferencváros had the second-highest crime density per capita after Kőbánya, with a roughly 50% increase in crimes-per-100,000-residents from 2021 to 2022; separately, it is also named as one of the two leading districts for vehicle theft in Budapest. Sources checked: Jozsefvarosujsag.hu, 10 Jul 2023 (five-district crime-density comparison); BPhirek.hu, 1 Jun 2023 (district vehicle-theft leaders); Metropol.hu, 20 Jul 2025 (30-day crime-hotspot map).
